rationale: The entry thesis of a short-covering bounce has failed, as price has stalled at the 9-EMA ($10.98) and is currently trading below it at $10.96, indicating that the initial volume spike was likely a sell-off rather than accumulation. With the stock sitting at the bottom of its range (2.3%) in a high-volatility environment (VIXY +7.32%) and no new catalysts, the risk of further downside toward the invalidation level outweighs the potential for a mean-reversion scalp.
